test.title: A video game or mobile game you have enjoyed playing

document.cue: Describe a video game or mobile game you have enjoyed playing.

text: The game I've enjoyed most recently is a football management game on my laptop. You don't actually play the matches yourself — instead, you're the manager of a club, so you buy and sell players, choose tactics and try to keep the owners happy.

I started playing it during the summer holidays two years ago, and now I usually play for an hour or so in the evenings, mostly at weekends. During exam periods I delete it completely, because otherwise I'd be tempted to play just one more season.

Most of the time I play on my own, but my best friend and I run rival clubs in an online league. Last month my team beat his in a cup final in the very last minute, and I still haven't let him forget it. We spend almost as much time arguing about transfers as actually playing.

I think I enjoy it because it's surprisingly mentally demanding. You have to plan several seasons ahead, manage a budget and deal with unexpected problems like injuries, which feels a bit like running a real business. It's also taught me a lot of English, because the whole game is full of news reports and interviews.
So for me it's not just entertainment — it's a hobby that actually keeps my brain busy.

tips.en: You don't actually play the matches yourself, instead prevents any misunderstanding.

tips.ru: It's surprisingly mentally demanding — причина, которой экзаменатор не ждёт.

note.en: What the game is — explained at once for someone who does not know it.
note.kk: Қандай ойын — және оны білмейтін адамға бірден түсіндірме.
note.ru: Что за игра — и сразу объяснение для того, кто её не знает.

note.en: When and how often — with an honest detail about exam periods.
note.kk: Қашан және қаншалықты жиі — емтихандар туралы шынайы дерекпен.
note.ru: Когда и как часто — с честной деталью про экзамены.

note.en: Who with — a friend and one story about a cup final.
note.kk: Кіммен ойнайды — дос және кубок финалы туралы бір оқиға.
note.ru: С кем играет — друг и одна история про финал кубка.

note.en: Why — an unexpected reason: the game develops thinking and English.
note.kk: Неге ұнайды — күтпеген себеп: ойын ойлау қабілетін және ағылшын тілін дамытады.
note.ru: Почему нравится — неожиданная причина: игра развивает мышление и английский.

note.en: The ending challenges the stereotype that games are a waste of time.
note.kk: Қорытынды «ойын — уақытты босқа өткізу» деген қалыптасқан пікірмен дауласады.
note.ru: Итог спорит со стереотипом «игры — пустая трата времени».
